construct: align-items: baseline on a flex row
why: Mixed type sizes on one row (a price beside a currency mark, a label beside a hint) sit on the shared baseline, and counterAxisAlignItems: 'BASELINE' is native on a HORIZONTAL auto-layout frame. `baseline` has been in LayoutSchema.align and in the emitter's ALIGN_FIGMA table all along; the enrichment vocabulary's align-items map simply did not list it, so the value fell to layout-value-outside-vocabulary and stayed code-only. The register named that boundary arbitrary rather than a carriage limit, and this case is the proof.
